sentences.text:
In Re: Indrajit Chakraborty & Ors.
 ...Pet
 Mr. Abhijit Singh,
 Ms. Sagmina Banerjee.
 .... For the Pet
 1.

This revisional application has been filed by the present petitioners who are the husband and the
in-laws.
2. There has been a long unexplained delay in filing the written complaint.

3. Heard submission of the learned Advocate perused the materials primarily it transpires that the case was started under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and subsequently the cognizance has been taken under Sections 498A/34 of the IPC against the accused person.
Prima facie, allegation appears to be omnibus in nature.
4. Hence, an arguable case has been made out before this Court for which the matter is required to be heard.
5. In view of the above, the instant revisional application is admitted.
6. The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite party.
7. The matter to appear as contested application four weeks hence before the regular bench.

8. Let there be stay of all further proceedings pending before the learned Magistrate till 30th April,
2026 or until further order whichever is earlier.
9.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
